title: Concept: Thymeleaf template error returned to a client
description: A Thymeleaf template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message names the template and the expression, which tells an attacker which server-side value is bound at that point and whether it is escaped.
applicability: Deployments that render a Thymeleaf template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message names the template and the expression, which tells an attacker which server-side value is bound at that point and whether it is escaped.
